1.t: Has there not been over Man a long period of Time, when he was nothing - (not even) mentioned?

2.t: Verily We created Man from a drop of mingled sperm, in order to try him: So We gave him (the gifts), of Hearing and Sight.

3.t: We showed him the Way: whether he be grateful or ungrateful (rests on his will).

4.t: For the Rejecters we have prepared chains, yokes, and a blazing Fire.

5.t: As to the Righteous, they shall drink of a Cup (of Wine) mixed with Kafur,-

6.t: A Fountain where the Devotees of Allah do drink, making it flow in unstinted abundance.

7.t: They perform (their) vows, and they fear a Day whose evil flies far and wide.

8.t: And they feed, for the love of Allah, the indigent, the orphan, and the captive,-

9.t: (Saying),"We feed you for the sake of Allah alone: no reward do we desire from you, nor thanks.

10.t: "We only fear a Day of distressful Wrath from the side of our Lord."

11.t: But Allah will deliver them from the evil of that Day, and will shed over them a Light of Beauty and (blissful) Joy.

12.t: And because they were patient and constant, He will reward them with a Garden and (garments of) silk.

13.t: Reclining in the (Garden) on raised thrones, they will see there neither the sun's (excessive heat) nor (the moon's) excessive cold.

14.t: And the shades of the (Garden) will come low over them, and the bunches (of fruit), there, will hang low in humility.

15.t: And amongst them will be passed round vessels of silver and goblets of crystal,-

16.t: Crystal-clear, made of silver: they will determine the measure thereof (according to their wishes).

17.t: And they will be given to drink there of a Cup (of Wine) mixed with Zanjabil,-

19.t: And round about them will (serve) youths of perpetual (freshness): If thou seest them, thou wouldst think them scattered Pearls.

20.t: And when thou lookest, it is there thou wilt see a Bliss and a Realm Magnificent.

21.t: Upon them will be green Garments of fine silk and heavy brocade, and they will be adorned with Bracelets of silver; and their Lord will give to them to drink of a Wine Pure and Holy.

22.t: "Verily this is a Reward for you, and your Endeavour is accepted and recognised."

23.t: It is We Who have sent down the Qur'an to thee by stages.

24.t: Therefore be patient with constancy to the Command of thy Lord, and hearken not to the sinner or the ingrate among them.

25.t: And celebrate the name of thy Lord morning and evening,

26.t: And part of the night, prostrate thyself to Him; and glorify Him a long night through.

27.t: As to these, they love the fleeting life, and put away behind them a Day (that will be) hard.

28.t: It is We Who created them, and We have made their joints strong; but, when We will, We can substitute the like of them by a complete change.

29.t: This is an admonition: Whosoever will, let him take a (straight) Path to his Lord.

30.t: But ye will not, except as Allah wills; for Allah is full of Knowledge and Wisdom.

31.t: He will admit to His Mercy whom He will; But the wrong-doers,- for them has He prepared a grievous Penalty.
